title: fix(app-shell): the Studio CEL editor refuses == / != on a list field while typing
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbD5gxSWeWGswbZYVzNvtqNM)_
Fixes #36219

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:Studio 对象设计器里写字段公式或显示/只读/必填条件时,对多值字段用等号比较,输入时就当场提示错误并给出改写,不再等到保存才被拒。
- 为什么做:属于“公式与条件校验”系列,替写条件的 Studio 作者把保存时才出现的报错提前到输入时。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是编辑器多报或漏报这一条提示,保存端的校验不变,数据不会写错;撤回本改动即恢复原样。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`CelPredicateField` takes a new optional `fieldDefs` prop (each field's `name`, `type`, `multiple`). It reads them through `multiValueFieldsOf` (`clientValidation.ts`), the object draft check's own derivation over `isMultiValueField` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), and puts the list-valued names into the lint hint as `multiValueFields`. `celAuthoring.ts` already spread that key into `validateExpression`, so it needed no change, and `packages/formula` is untouched.

The editor hands over `multiValueFields` only, not `fieldTypes`, so it judges list fields exactly as the save-side draft check does. Adding `fieldTypes` would also turn on the type-soundness advisories, which the save path does not pass either. That is a separate behaviour and is not in this card.

**Shared point vs. threading.** `CelPredicateField` knows only `objectName` and field names. Loading the object catalog inside it (`useObjectFields`) would read the *saved* object, while the object designer edits an unsaved *draft*, so the editor would judge stale fields. The mounts already hold the right definitions (the draft's `view.entries`, the condition builder's `fields`), so each inspector mount passes them. The list-field derivation exists once: `multiValueFieldsOf` in `clientValidation.ts`, now exported and taking `{ name, type, multiple }` definitions. The draft check calls it with its `view.entries` mapped to that shape, and `CelPredicateField` calls it with `fieldDefs`, so the editor and the save judge the same fields as lists. It lives there and not in `celAuthoring.ts` because that module deliberately carries no import at load, and the helper needs `isMultiValueField`.

### Every `CelPredicateField` mount (app-shell, non-test, at this head)

| Mount | Conclusion |
|---|---|
| `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` formula (`expression`, `role="value"`) | changed: `fieldDefs={celFieldDefs}` |
| `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` stored expression | changed |
| `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` `visibleWhen` | changed, pinned by the new test |
| `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` `readonlyWhen` | changed |
| `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` `requiredWhen` | changed |
| `inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx` raw CEL box | changed: `fieldDefs={fields}` (the catalog the builder already holds, `type` + `multiple`, hidden fields included) |
| `ConditionalFormattingEditor.tsx` (view conditional formatting, `scope="record"`) | out of scope: not an inspectors mount (card ruling) and no save-side draft check feeds it `multiValueFields`. Noted below. |
| `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` field `when` (RLS CHECK, flattened) | out of scope: not an inspectors mount; at a flattened site the engine judges bare names only under `faultOutcome: 'run-fails'`, which this lint never sends, so the hint would change nothing |
| `PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` RLS `USING` | out of scope: same reason as above |
| `PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` RLS `CHECK` | out of scope: same reason as above |

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.listEquality-36219.test.tsx`, against the real `@objectstack/formula`. It drives the inspector's `visibleWhen` mount:
- `record.stage == 'qa'` on a `select` declared `multiple: true` holds Save (the blocking count is 1) and shows the `` `record.stage` holds a list `` refusal.
- Scalar control: `record.single == 'qa'` on a plain `select` is clean (count 0, no refusal).

<details><summary>Runs (head ef819785ca)</summary>

- Head ef819785ca (one derivation): the new test, `ObjectFieldInspector.celGate`, `ObjectFieldInspector.hostBanner-12681` (it mocks `clientValidation` by spreading the original), `CelPredicateField.test` and every `clientValidation*` test file, under the lock: `Test Files 16 passed (16) · Tests 252 passed (252)`. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: TYPECHECK_EXIT=0, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

Earlier head 349fc44da:

- New test plus neighbours (`ObjectFieldInspector.celGate`, `CelPredicateField.test`, `clientValidation.listEquality-36167`): `Test Files 4 passed (4) · Tests 41 passed (41)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation (the fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `fields: fieldNames, multiValueFields, clause` → `fields: fieldNames, clause`, x1 → x0, blob 442c5c89c717 → c3bf3117bfe8): the multiple-select case went red at the blocking-count wait (line 74) and the scalar control stayed green, `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`. Restored: blob == HEAD (442c5c89c717) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. There is no `dist/` leg because the test resolves app-shell from source.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so it covers the test) after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure: TYPECHECK_EXIT=0, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ConditionalFormattingEditor.tsx` lints `record.FIELD` at `scope="record"` and would accept `fieldDefs` the same way. I left it alone because it is outside this card's inspector ruling, and no save-side check that this card could compare against refuses the shape there. carrier: #36459
- `CelPredicateField` is not exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s published surface: the package is `private: true`. Adding an optional prop therefore changes no built `.d.ts` that anything outside the package reads.

## Verification

Read first: `CelPredicateField.tsx`, the `multiValueFieldsOf` helper and the hint line in the debounced lint effect (the risk is the effect's dependency key `multiKey`); then the `celFieldDefs` line in `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.listEquality-36219.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1`. Expect 2 passed.
